name: 22.QF4

movements.notes: same barbell throughout; athlete's own max-load complex; no fixed Rx weight

origin.summary: Test 4 of the 2022 CrossFit Quarterfinals. The Quarterfinals sit between the worldwide Open and the Semifinals in the CrossFit Games season — a harder online stage for the top slice of Open finishers.

description: A one-rep-max barbell complex — clean into bench press into overhead squat — on the same bar throughout.
